name: The AssistTaxi Dataset
description: A multi-airport dataset for runway and taxiway scene understanding, spanning day, dusk, and night conditions across three U.S. airports. This expanded dataset incorporates over 900,000 high-resolution frames collected from general aviation and commercial airports during day, night, and varying weather scenarios. The dataset also provides fine-grained annotations using a semi-automated labeling pipeline across temporally consistent video frames, significantly reducing manual intervention while increasing annotation accuracy. AssistTaxi offers a valuable benchmark for training, evaluating, and validating AI models intended for autonomous ground operations in aviation.
